extracted.intended_audience: Idaho state agency rule writers and administrative staff (rule coordinators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required resources for drafting, submitting, and publishing administrative rules under the Idaho Administrative Procedure Act. Covers procedural steps, required forms, publication schedules, and distinctions between rules and nonbinding guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of rulemaking (Idaho APA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking is the process for the formulation, adoption, amendment, or repeal of a rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quoted from the Idaho Administrative Procedure Act (Title 67, Chapter 52, Idaho Code). Use this statutory definition to determine when an action constitutes formal rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and function of rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Through rules, an agency interprets, prescribes, and implements statutory law; and clarifies, standardizes, or establishes its procedure or practice requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When drafting rules, ensure they are used to implement or clarify statutory authority and to establish consistent procedures or practice standards rather than merely stating internal policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with the Idaho Administrative Procedure Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking is governed by the Idaho Administrative Procedure Act (Title 67, Chapter 52, Idaho Code).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All rule development, adoption, amendment, and repeal must follow the statutory procedures and requirements set out in the APA; consult the APA text for procedural and substantive legal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinction between rules and policy/guidance documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency policy statements and guidance documents shall not have the force and effect of law pursuant to Section 67-5207A, Idaho Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that materials intended to have legal effect are promulgated as rules under the APA; do not rely on policy statements or guidance to create binding legal obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Rule Writer’s Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule Writer’s Manuals — Guides to Idaho's rulemaking process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Rule Writer’s Manual for detailed instructions and best practices on drafting rule language, formatting, and procedural compliance; it serves as a primary drafting resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use prescribed Rulemaking Templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking Templates — Templates, forms, and other supporting documents required for rulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare rule documents using the official templates and forms to ensure consistent formatting and inclusion of required sections and metadata for submission and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit Administrative Rules Request Form (ARRF)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the ARRF as part of the formal submission/request process for initiating rulemaking within the state administrative system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the Rulemaking Process step-by-step guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Rulemaking Process — Step-by-step guide: overview of Idaho’s rulemaking steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the documented step-by-step process (notice, hearings, adoption, filing, publication, etc.) to ensure statutory compliance and valid rule promulgation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to the Bulletin Publication Schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Bulletin Publication Schedule — Rulemaking cycle deadlines for the calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe the bulletin schedule and internal deadlines for submitting notices and proposed rules so that publications and comment periods occur within the required timeframes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Townhall Idaho for meetings and hearings
rubrics_metrics.description: Townhall Idaho — One-stop-shop for all scheduled rulemaking meetings and hearings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post and locate scheduled rulemaking meetings and hearings via Townhall Idaho; use this portal for public notice and participation logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish Legal Notice of proposed rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal Notice — Notices of proposed rules, found in each bulletin, published in Idaho newspapers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide legal notice of proposed rules as required, including publication in the bulletin and Idaho newspapers to notify the public and trigger comment/hearing periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare and maintain History Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: History Notes — Annual compilation of Rules Sections affected by legislative review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include and update history notes documenting legislative review and changes to rule sections; maintain this record as part of the rule file and public documentation.
